en.headline: MTR Tuen Ma Line resumes after engineering vehicle fault at Tin Shui Wai
en.dek: The MTR said a defective engineering train at Tin Shui Wai Station had been moved clear by 6:20 this morning, with services gradually returning to normal after temporary delays of 10 to 15 minutes.
body: The MTR Corporation reported that an engineering vehicle developed a fault at Tin Shui Wai Station on the Tuen Ma Line early this morning, temporarily lengthening waiting times.

According to the operator, passengers were advised that trains between Tuen Mun and Yuen Long would run about every 25 minutes and between Yuen Long and Wu Kai Sha every 8 minutes, with waits expected to be 10 to 15 minutes longer than usual. Free shuttle buses were arranged between Yuen Long and Tuen Mun stations.

By 6:20, the MTR said the defective engineering train had been moved off the running line and that Tuen Ma Line services were gradually resuming. The shuttle bus service was due to end at 6:30. Transport Department notices confirmed the update.

zh.headline: 天水圍站工程車故障已處理 屯馬綫服務逐步回復正常
zh.dek: 港鐵表示今早天水圍站有工程車設備故障，列車已於6時20分左右駛離行車綫，屯馬綫服務逐步回復正常，較早時候候車時間曾延長10至15分鐘。
body: 港鐵公司今早通報，天水圍站有工程車出現設備故障，一度調整屯馬綫列車班次。
港鐵指，屯門往來元朗的班次調整至約每25分鐘一班，元朗往來烏溪沙則約每8分鐘一班，候車時間預計較平日多10至15分鐘，並安排免費接駁巴士來往元朗站及屯門站。
港鐵於上午6時20分表示，故障工程車已駛離行車綫，屯馬綫列車服務正逐步回復正常。運輸署亦確認有關更新，接駁巴士服務於6時30分結束。
